cohort: The study included 91,894 women who had children in public and private hospitals between 2012 and 2017.
finding: High maternal age and the source of healthcare payment influence the mode of delivery, which in turn interferes with the length of hospital stay.
mod_finding: The proportion of cesarean sections was higher in supplementary health services and among women aged 31 to 40 years old, while vaginal deliveries were more common in public care.
